answer: Work waits on the relic until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the lagoon of the next round. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Reaching the quartz of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, re-queued for a second panel, the unit of trust is a task, not an address.
